public_build_note: Every build made from this repository is a public repackaged build and is hardware-untested. A status below describes the maintainer's private lab evidence for the same feature, not your build.

private-lab-verified.label: Verified on a private lab build
private-lab-verified.text: Worked on the maintainer's private lab builds. Those builds share the feature code but also carry extra diagnostics, so their compiled images differ. Your public build is hardware-untested.

hardware-untested.label: Hardware-untested public build
hardware-untested.text: Host-tested; no camera has run this feature in this public configuration yet.

experimental.label: Experimental
experimental.text: Not confirmed on a camera in this public configuration; any private trial is described in the detail.

startup_wav.label: Startup sound (WAV)
startup_wav.cli_help: Path to 48 kHz mono 16-bit PCM WAVE startup clip

shutter_wav.label: Shutter sound (WAV)
shutter_wav.cli_help: Path to 48 kHz mono 16-bit PCM WAVE shutter clip

profile_cli_help: Build profile: shutter-feedback (default, requires two WAVs) or xpan-crop (no WAVs; silent unless --record-indicator or --record-stop-indicator)
profile_exclusivity: XPan and custom sounds aren't offered together. The XPan profile is silent by design, and private lab estimates suggest both together would exceed the camera's free memory. That combination has not been tested.

profiles.label: Custom startup and shutter sounds
profiles.description: Plays your own startup clip after the camera starts and your own shutter clip on single shots, through the camera speaker. No XPan.
profiles.status_detail: Private build36 played both clips with normal photo capture on 16 GB SDHC and 128 GB SDXC cards.

profiles.label: XPan 2.71:1 crop (silent)
profiles.description: Replaces 16:9 with a 2.71:1 XPan crop: menu and Q label, live LCD/EVF framing, saved JPEG/RAW crop, playback masking and immediate XPan bars in automatic review. Adds no sounds unless you pick a record start or stop cue.
profiles.status_detail: Menu, Q label, live framing, saved crop, playback masking and automatic review were confirmed on private lab builds (17-18 November 2026). Other qualities, modes and active auto-rotation are unverified.

options.label: Movie record indicator
options.description: Plays a short generated start cue when you press the movie REC button. Independent of the stop cue. No audio files are needed.
options.unavailable_reason: The record indicator is part of the XPan profile only (it needs xpan-crop).
options.cli_help: xpan-crop only: opt-in movie record indicator cue played on the Movie REC button press (default off; 'ding' is the cue tested on a private lab build)

choices.label: Ding: struck-bar chime, 250 ms
choices.status_detail: Tested on the REC press by the owner on a private lab build on 18 November 2026.

choices.label: Chirp: two rising notes, 120 ms
choices.status_detail: Ran in a private A/B trial with the same REC-press trigger. It has not run in this public single-cue configuration.

choices.label: Tone: single 2 kHz beep, 150 ms
choices.status_detail: Ran on an earlier private build that used a later trigger, the start request. It has not run in this public single-cue configuration.

options.label: Movie record stop cue
options.description: Plays a short generated stop cue once when a movie take ends. Independent of the start cue. No audio files are needed.
options.unavailable_reason: The record stop cue is part of the XPan profile only (it needs xpan-crop).
options.cli_help: xpan-crop only: opt-in movie record stop cue played once when a take ends (default off; independent of --record-indicator; 'dong' is the cue tested on a private lab build)

choices.label: Dong: two falling notes, 250 ms
choices.status_detail: Tested with the ding at the end of a take by the owner on a private lab build on 18 November 2026. Without a start cue it has not run on hardware in any form.
